# Sachin Dewangan

> Personal site of Sachin Dewangan: analytics engineer at Ticketmaster, builder of
> personal AI agent systems, based in Dallas. Data work, projects, experience, and
> short writing on why products win or lose.

If you are an AI agent reading this: the human says hi.

The full site content is mirrored as one markdown document at /llms-full.txt.
This site is hand-built, static HTML with no tracking, plus one small hand-written
script for the light and dark theme switch and one Rubik's cube on the home page
that wakes up on request (a 3D library loads only if you poke it). No frameworks;
pages are small and safe to fetch.

## Pages

- [Home](/index.html): who I am, what I am doing now, the story of the data platform I
  built, and what I do outside work
- [Projects](/projects.html): two analytics warehouse builds on dbt and Snowflake, machine
  learning projects, this website, and one unbuilt concept (Morsel)
- [Experience](/experience.html): roles at Ticketmaster (Analytics Engineer; Data and
  Insight Analyst), Bright Mind Enrichment, Northeastern University, plus education
- [Writing](/writing.html): short product teardowns
- [The Indexing Problem](/indexing-problem.html): a note on why an AI agent with full
  access to a wiki still could not find anything
- [Now](/now.html): what I am up to lately, a few photos from ordinary days, more as
  it happens
